children: Soulpower Acquisition entered into a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with SWB Holdings and SWB. The amendment adds a Uruguay contribution to occur after closing for $5 million in cash, with potential Pubco Class A shares tied to milestones, and adjusts the merger consideration to reflect these changes and allocate certain Carident AG shares. It also clarifies net asset calculations, removes interim covenants for additional contributions, and extends the Outside Date to April 2, 2027. The changes are intended to finalize deal mechanics and provide more time to close.
: Second Amendment to Business Combination Agreement
: Modify consideration, finalize contributions, and extend time to close
